title: Thursday small sync — prep & actions (Kai)
content:
Meeting: Thursday small sync (15m) — Kai notes / quick prep
Date: Thu 2026-03-12 10:30am PT
Attendees (expected): Kai, Maya, Arjun, Ellie (brief), SRE on-call? maybe Tom
Goal: sync on 2 priority items (console rollout checklist + runtime fallback telemetry), confirm owners for next steps, capture blockers and quick wins.

Quick TL;DR to open with (30s):
- Console rollout still on track; staging drift discovered (schema mismatch in route mapping) — need 1-hour window to patch.
- Fallback telemetry: missing KV-cache hit metric in traces, causes blind spots for canary.

Agenda (15m total):
1) 0:00–0:04 — Recent regressions & hot items (Kai)
   - show p50/p95 dashboard for console-api (last 24h) — callout: small spike at 04:00 UTC (deploy?)
   - note: staging route-mapping error: PR #842 introduced new optional field, console UI expects old shape — quick mitigation: compatibility layer in proxy (Maya)

2) 0:04–0:09 — Fallback telemetry gap (Arjun)
   - problem: when we fallback from hosted->dedicated variant, KV cache hit metric lost in tracing span; impacts quality-rollback decisions
   - ask: agree owner to add explicit cache-hit counter and tag on fallback path (instrumentation + OTEL enrich)

3) 0:09–0:12 — Ops window / patch plan (Maya)
   - propose 1-hour staging patch tomorrow 9am PT; rollback plan in Slack thread and Canary toggles
   - need quick AB test config to keep old mapping for 10% traffic while patch rolls out

4) 0:12–0:15 — Round-robin action assignment & quick blockers (Kai)

Prep notes / what to show:
- Dashboard links to open in meeting: p50/p95 + errors by route (copy these into chat before start)
- Small terminal demo of failing mapping (2 commands) — keep it snappy
- Minimal code diff snippet for instrumentation change (Arjun) so people understand scope

Open questions / discussion prompts (use if we have extra time):
- Can we get a short-term automated alert on schema drift between console and runtime model contracts? (SRE + platform)
- Tradeoffs: compat-layer in proxy vs. force-update on UI — which has lower blast radius?

Action items (quick list — capture in meeting notes live):
- [ ] Maya: Prepare staging patch + rollback steps, schedule 1h window (due: 2026-03-13 09:00 PT)
- [ ] Arjun: Add cache-hit counter + OTEL tag on fallback path; open PR and attach tests (due: 2026-03-16)
- [ ] Kai: Post dashboard links and short runbook in #serving-runtime thread before meeting start (done before 10:25am)
- [ ] Ellie: Verify canary toggle config supports 10% traffic AB (due: 2026-03-13 EOD)
- [ ] Tom (SRE): Review alert sensitivity for schema drift and give recommendation (due: 2026-03-14)

Notes-to-self / scratch thoughts (don't read aloud unless needed):
- If Arjun's change is small (counter + tag), consider adding a synthetic check keyed by variant-id so fallback rate shows up in metrics pipeline quickly.
- Might need to add a simple e2e in staging: send request that exercises optional field, ensure mapping works when UI hits new/old shapes. Link: CONFLUENCE-ENG-CONSOLE-DesignNotes -> add checklist item.
- Keep timeline realistic: don't promise immediate rollouts — team bandwidth this sprint is tight (2 people on travel Wed–Thu).

Follow-ups after the meeting (post-meeting template to fill):
- Update meeting note with decisions, copy action items into JIRA tickets, tag assignees
- Quick retrospective next Friday if rollout touches prod: what failed, what helped, follow-up fixes

Scratchpad TODOs (personal):
- Send calendar invite update if staging window confirmed
- Draft Slack post with TL;DR and links
- Check PR #842 for any other breaking changes across other routes

References / quick links:
- jira: JIRA-5621 (console mapping bug)
- pr: github.com/redwood-inference/console-ui/pull/842
- confluence: CONFLUENCE-ENG-CONSOLE-DesignNotes
- slack: #serving-runtime thread (pin when done)

End of prep — keep under 15m. If things spill, push instrumentation deep-dives to separate sync.

---
Personal quick log: 2026-03-12 10:05am — Sent prep links to thread. 10:28am — Maya said staging window OK. Update meeting notes after sync.
